text:
Hello my fellow fisher people! :fishing_pole_and_fish::olake: (forgive me, I'm still looking for the right name for us)

We'd like to get to know you all a little better! If you have some time, please fill out this <https://forms.gle/9zoxEeGDoxEhqDC5A|reallllllyyyy short survey> and in return you will get a $10 (or equivalent) Amazon gift card in your mailbox!

In case you want your gc on an ID that isn't the same as your Slack, please DM me with your preferred email ID and I will send it to you on there.

Here's another link to the form - <https://forms.gle/9zoxEeGDoxEhqDC5A|forms.gle/…>
